trailhead.label: The tourist office in Mezzano, the APT’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
The rope suspension bridge over the Rio San Piero at km 3.4: about 70 m long, 30 m up, swaying, with a see-through metal grating floor.
About 2.3 km on tarmac, the first climb out of Mezzano in full sun.
Road crossings in Mezzano and Imer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
